content.description: A 3D grouped bar chart showing Wine Excise Tax Collections by Type in millions of dollars for the fiscal years ended 1998 through 2012. Unfortified wine excise tax is represented by tall purple bars that grow steadily from around $8 million in 1998 to over $20 million in 2012. Fortified wine excise tax is represented by small patterned bars that remain consistently low, around $1 to $2 million, throughout the period.
content.caption: Figure 13.1 Wine Excise Tax Collections by Type

content.description: A 3D 100% stacked bar chart showing Fortified and Unfortified Wine Excise Tax Collections as a percentage of Total Wine Excise Tax Collections for the fiscal years ended 1998 through 2012. The light purple lower segments represent unfortified wine, which consistently accounts for approximately 90% or more of the total each year. The dark purple upper segments represent fortified wine, making up the small remaining percentage.
content.caption: Figure 13.2 Fortified and Unfortified Wine Excise Tax Collections as a % of Total Wine Excise Tax Collections
